text.en_us: Hold to open the build-mode radial menu; release to apply the highlighted mode. HOLD mode only - the pairing forces it. This 1.20.1 build opens the menu from Forge InputEvent.Key (hence the eventBus channel) and closes it from a raw key poll, so all three channels are required. The right stick snaps the cursor onto a wedge; the left stick stays free for the buttons outside the ring.
text.zh_cn: 按住打开建造模式环形菜单，松开时应用高亮模式。只能用 HOLD 模式（配对会强制）。1.20.1 这版靠 Forge InputEvent.Key 打开菜单（因此需要 eventBus），又靠裸按键轮询判断松手，所以三个通道缺一不可。右摇杆把光标吸附到扇区，左摇杆保持自由以够到环外的按钮。
